rotation: ISO week_number % len(presets); overrides via weeks{} keys

presets.title: Hardcore Combat — Weekly Hunt (V8: Mech Attack + Spider Run + Phone Mix + Pincer Tell)
presets.goal: Clear 3 hunter waves (8 hunters) with PULSE; V8 closes the animation gaps — the mech now plays a synthetic attack role with a procedural shoulder-piston punch and the spider gets a distinct faster run clip (no vendor GLB edits) — and masters the phone mix: combat one-shots sit 14 dB above the ambience bed and EMP/hit duck the footstep layer (SMOKE_SFX duck=1 combat_above_ambi=1). Pincer pressure gets an earlier two-hunter pre-tell plus a partner ground ring and a dedicated HUD strip, with V6's 16-tick delay, 38-tick hold and every hunter stat unchanged (no softener). V7 hit/death cam, same-side cover nav (HUNT_FULL still 1635 ticks), anim_v1 loops, mid-wave SURGE, V6 audio/debris/pincer/EMP stay. Chain 4 PULSE hits for an EMP stun; avoid toxic zones, then extract.
presets.goal_zh: PULSE 清 3 波共 8 名猎人；V8 补齐动画缺口——机甲新增合成攻击动作 + 程序化肩部活塞拳，蜘蛛获得独立的更快奔跑 clip（不改 vendor GLB）；并做手机混音：战斗单发音效高于环境底噪 14 dB，EMP/命中时脚步自动压低（SMOKE_SFX duck=1 combat_above_ambi=1）。夹击新增更早的双猎人预警 + 伙伴地面红环 + 专用 HUD 提示条，V6 的 16 tick 预提交延迟、38 tick 持续与全部猎人数值不变（不软化）。V7 受击/死亡镜头、同侧掩体导航（HUNT_FULL 仍 1635 tick）、anim_v1 循环、中波 SURGE、V6 音频/碎块/夹击/EMP 全部保留。PULSE 连击 4 次触发 EMP 眩晕；避开毒区后撤离。

how_to_rotate: Client computes ISO week id in Asia/Shanghai (weekly.js).
Lookup weeks[week_id]; if missing, fall back to presets[week_number % N] + synthesized ops_seed_label.
V1 (optional): publish signed weekly bundles with layout.seed derived from ops_seed; keep BundleGate.
To hand-edit a week: add/replace key under weeks in this JSON and redeploy ops overlay (no wasm required for copy-only).
Multipack: set pack_id on weeks/presets from REGISTERED_PACKS (3d_short_challenge.v1 primary; goose_hotseat.v1 only via pack_seeds / ops).
V9: a second signed arena (neon_hardcore_combat_84124 Alley Pincer) is linked from landing; weekly default stays 84123 W44 until an explicit rotation lands in weeks{}.
V10: campaign is a separate primary CTA (campaign=1 on A); weekly featured stays 84123/W44 until an explicit weeks{} rotation.
V11: signed campaign chain is A(84123) → B(84124) → C(84125 Core Breach); campaign-only HP carry, win only after C. Weekly featured stays 84123/W44.

hp_carry.rule: HP is stashed from the ceiling boot at each stage win and restored after the next stage boots; solo A/B/C always start at full HP; death on any stage ends the campaign

campaign.win_rule: campaign_win only after stage 3 (84125 Core Breach) clear; stage 1/2 clears advance, never win
campaign.fail_rule: death/timeout on any stage ends the campaign attempt
